rationale: C20 is a plausible material template because it is an earlier reply to the same foreign leader and organizes substantially similar material around hemispheric economic development, reciprocal cooperation, consultation, exchange of views, and continued intergovernmental relations. The child expands and adapts that framework to the Alliance for Progress, adding detailed arguments about industrialization and social development. C01 has related recovery-program rhetoric, and C21 shares the response-and-cooperation structure, but neither matches the child's recipient, regional setting, and linked sequence of economic concern, consultation, and cooperative action as closely as C20.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Many problems beset the effort to enlarge economic abundance, cultural opportunity and social justice for all the people of the hemisphere.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The necessity for each nation in this hemisphere to realize more rapid economic growth goes without saying.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the correspondence around hemisphere-wide economic development.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I see the process as one of intimate cooperation among the free republics of the hemisphere, in which each will pool his ideas and experience in order to promote the growth of all.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I believe that in the present world situation it is more essential than ever for us to reaffirm the Pan-American tradition of cooperation and consultation.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts the parent's Pan-American cooperation-and-consultation framework into collective development through the Alliance for Progress.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I warmly welcome your desire for continued consultations between our Governments and for the pooling of our efforts and ideas
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The desirability of joint consultation and discussions on economic factors and problems which are of mutual concern and impact is equally clear.
shared_material.explanation: The closing emphasis on continued governmental consultation about shared economic problems closely parallels the earlier letter.
